verses.original: הִנֵּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בּוֹקֵ֥ק הָאָ֖רֶץ וּבֽוֹלְקָ֑הּ וְעִוָּ֣ה פָנֶ֔יהָ וְהֵפִ֖יץ יֹשְׁבֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh Yah·weh bō·w·qêq hā·’ā·reṣ ū·ḇō·wl·qāh wə·‘iw·wāh p̄ā·ne·hā wə·hê·p̄îṣ yō·šə·ḇe·hā
verses.literal: Behold the LORD lays waste the earth and leaves it in ruins He will twist its surface and scatter its inhabitants

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה כָעָם֙ כַּכֹּהֵ֔ן כַּעֶ֙בֶד֙ כַּֽאדֹנָ֔יו כַּשִּׁפְחָ֖ה כַּגְּבִרְתָּ֑הּ כַּקּוֹנֶה֙ כַּמּוֹכֵ֔ר כַּמַּלְוֶה֙ כַּלֹּוֶ֔ה כַּנֹּשֶׁ֕ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר נֹשֶׁ֥א בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḵā·‘ām kak·kō·hên ka·‘e·ḇeḏ ka·ḏō·nāw kaš·šip̄·ḥāh kag·gə·ḇir·tāh kaq·qō·w·neh kam·mō·w·ḵêr kam·mal·weh kal·lō·weh kan·nō·šeh ka·’ă·šer nō·še ḇōw
verses.literal: people and priest alike servant and master maid and mistress buyer and seller lender and borrower . . . creditor and debtor

verses.original: הִבּ֧וֹק׀ תִּבּ֛וֹק הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהִבּ֣וֹז׀ תִּבּ֑וֹז כִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hib·bō·wq tib·bō·wq hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hib·bō·wz tib·bō·wz kî Yah·weh dib·ber ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: The earth will be utterly laid waste and thoroughly plundered For the LORD has spoken this word

verses.original: אָבְלָ֤ה נָֽבְלָה֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֻמְלְלָ֥ה נָבְלָ֖ה תֵּבֵ֑ל אֻמְלָ֖לוּ מְר֥וֹם עַם־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇə·lāh nā·ḇə·lāh hā·’ā·reṣ ’um·lə·lāh nā·ḇə·lāh tê·ḇêl ’um·lā·lū mə·rō·wm ‘am- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The earth mourns and withers the world languishes and fades the exalted of the earth waste away

verses.original: וְהָאָ֥רֶץ חָנְפָ֖ה תַּ֣חַת יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ כִּֽי־ עָבְר֤וּ תוֹרֹת֙ חָ֣לְפוּ חֹ֔ק הֵפֵ֖רוּ בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ā·reṣ ḥā·nə·p̄āh ta·ḥaṯ yō·šə·ḇe·hā kî- ‘ā·ḇə·rū ṯō·w·rōṯ ḥā·lə·p̄ū ḥōq hê·p̄ê·rū bə·rîṯ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: The earth is defiled by its people they have transgressed the laws they have overstepped the decrees and broken the everlasting covenant

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֗ן אָלָה֙ אָ֣כְלָה אֶ֔רֶץ וַֽיֶּאְשְׁמ֖וּ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָ֑הּ עַל־ כֵּ֗ן חָרוּ֙ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי אֶ֔רֶץ וְנִשְׁאַ֥ר אֱנ֖וֹשׁ מִזְעָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ’ā·lāh ’ā·ḵə·lāh ’e·reṣ way·ye’·šə·mū yō·šə·ḇê ḇāh ‘al- kên ḥā·rū yō·šə·ḇê ’e·reṣ wə·niš·’ar ’ĕ·nō·wōš miz·‘ār
verses.literal: Therefore . . . a curse has consumed the earth and its inhabitants must bear the guilt the earth’s dwellers - have been burned and only a few . . . survive

verses.original: אָבַ֥ל תִּיר֖וֹשׁ אֻמְלְלָה־ גָ֑פֶן נֶאֶנְח֖וּ כָּל־ שִׂמְחֵי־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇal tî·rō·wōš ’um·lə·lāh- ḡā·p̄en ne·’en·ḥū kāl- śim·ḥê- lêḇ
verses.literal: The new wine dries up the vine withers All the merrymakers . . . now groan

verses.original: שָׁבַת֙ מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ תֻּפִּ֔ים חָדַ֖ל שְׁא֣וֹן עַלִּיזִ֑ים שָׁבַ֖ת מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ כִּנּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ḇaṯ mə·śō·wś tup·pîm ḥā·ḏal šə·’ō·wn ‘al·lî·zîm šā·ḇaṯ mə·śō·wś kin·nō·wr
verses.literal: The joyful tambourines have ceased the noise of revelers has stopped the joyful harp is silent

verses.original: בַּשִּׁ֖יר לֹ֣א יִשְׁתּוּ־ יָ֑יִן יֵמַ֥ר שֵׁכָ֖ר לְשֹׁתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: baš·šîr lō yiš·tū- yā·yin yê·mar šê·ḵār lə·šō·ṯāw
verses.literal: They no longer sing and drink wine strong drink is bitter to those who consume it

verses.original: נִשְׁבְּרָ֖ה קִרְיַת־ תֹּ֑הוּ סֻגַּ֥ר כָּל־ בַּ֖יִת מִבּֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: niš·bə·rāh qir·yaṯ- tō·hū sug·gar kāl- ba·yiṯ mib·bō·w
verses.literal: The city of chaos is shattered every house is closed to entry

verses.original: צְוָחָ֥ה עַל־ הַיַּ֖יִן בַּֽחוּצ֑וֹת עָֽרְבָה֙ כָּל־ שִׂמְחָ֔ה גָּלָ֖ה מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣə·wā·ḥāh ‘al- hay·ya·yin ba·ḥū·ṣō·wṯ ‘ā·rə·ḇāh kāl- śim·ḥāh gā·lāh mə·śō·wś hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: In the streets they cry out for wine All joy turns to gloom rejoicing is exiled from the land

verses.original: נִשְׁאַ֥ר בָּעִ֖יר שַׁמָּ֑ה וּשְׁאִיָּ֖ה יֻכַּת־ שָֽׁעַר׃
verses.transliteration: niš·’ar bā·‘îr šam·māh ū·šə·’î·yāh yuk·kaṯ- šā·‘ar
verses.literal: The city is left in ruins its gate is reduced to rubble

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה יִהְיֶ֛ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָ֖רֶץ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָֽעַמִּ֑ים כְּנֹ֣קֶף זַ֔יִת כְּעוֹלֵלֹ֖ת אִם־ כָּלָ֥ה בָצִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh yih·yeh bə·qe·reḇ hā·’ā·reṣ bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘am·mîm kə·nō·qep̄ za·yiṯ kə·‘ō·w·lê·lōṯ ’im- kā·lāh ḇā·ṣîr
verses.literal: So . . . will it be on the earth and among the nations like a harvested olive tree like a gleaning after . . . a grape harvest

verses.original: הֵ֛מָּה יִשְׂא֥וּ קוֹלָ֖ם יָרֹ֑נּוּ בִּגְא֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה צָהֲל֖וּ מִיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh yiś·’ū qō·w·lām yā·rōn·nū biḡ·’ō·wn Yah·weh ṣā·hă·lū mî·yām
verses.literal: They raise their voices they shout for joy from the west they proclaim the majesty of the LORD

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֥ן בָּאֻרִ֖ים כַּבְּד֣וּ יְהוָ֑ה בְּאִיֵּ֣י הַיָּ֔ם שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên bā·’u·rîm kab·bə·ḏū Yah·weh bə·’î·yê hay·yām šêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Therefore glorify the LORD . . . in the east Extol the name of the LORD the God of Israel in the islands of the sea

verses.original: מִכְּנַ֨ף הָאָ֜רֶץ זְמִרֹ֤ת שָׁמַ֙עְנוּ֙ צְבִ֣י לַצַּדִּ֔יק וָאֹמַ֛ר רָזִי־ לִ֥י רָֽזִי־ לִ֖י א֣וֹי לִ֑י בֹּגְדִ֣ים בָּגָ֔דוּ וּבֶ֥גֶד בּוֹגְדִ֖ים בָּגָֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mik·kə·nap̄ hā·’ā·reṣ zə·mi·rōṯ šā·ma‘·nū ṣə·ḇî laṣ·ṣad·dîq wā·’ō·mar rā·zî- lî rā·zî- lî ’ō·w lî bō·ḡə·ḏîm bā·ḡā·ḏū ū·ḇe·ḡeḏ bō·wḡ·ḏîm bā·ḡā·ḏū
verses.literal: From the ends of the earth we hear singing Glory to the Righteous One But I said I am wasting away I am wasting away Woe is me The treacherous betray the treacherous deal in treachery

verses.original: פַּ֥חַד וָפַ֖חַת וָפָ֑ח עָלֶ֖יךָ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: pa·ḥaḏ wā·p̄a·ḥaṯ wā·p̄āḥ ‘ā·le·ḵā yō·wō·šêḇ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Terror and pit and snare await you O dweller of the earth

verses.original: וְֽ֠הָיָה הַנָּ֞ס מִקּ֤וֹל הַפַּ֙חַד֙ יִפֹּ֣ל אֶל־ הַפַּ֔חַת וְהָֽעוֹלֶה֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַפַּ֔חַת יִלָּכֵ֖ד בַּפָּ֑ח כִּֽי־ אֲרֻבּ֤וֹת מִמָּרוֹם֙ נִפְתָּ֔חוּ וַֽיִּרְעֲשׁ֖וּ מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh han·nās miq·qō·wl hap·pa·ḥaḏ yip·pōl ’el- hap·pa·ḥaṯ wə·hā·‘ō·w·leh mit·tō·wḵ hap·pa·ḥaṯ yil·lā·ḵêḏ bap·pāḥ kî- ’ă·rub·bō·wṯ mim·mā·rō·wm nip̄·tā·ḥū way·yir·‘ă·šū mō·ws·ḏê ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Whoever flees the sound of panic will fall into the pit and whoever climbs from the pit will be caught in the snare For the windows of heaven are open and the foundations of the earth are shaken

verses.original: רֹ֥עָה הִֽתְרֹעֲעָ֖ה הָאָ֑רֶץ פּ֤וֹר הִֽתְפּוֹרְרָה֙ אֶ֔רֶץ מ֥וֹט הִֽתְמוֹטְטָ֖ה אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: rō·‘āh hiṯ·rō·‘ă·‘āh hā·’ā·reṣ pō·wr hiṯ·pō·wr·rāh ’e·reṣ mō·wṭ hiṯ·mō·wṭ·ṭāh ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The earth is utterly broken apart . . . the earth is split open . . . the earth is shaken violently . . .

verses.original: נ֣וֹעַ תָּנ֤וּעַ אֶ֙רֶץ֙ כַּשִּׁכּ֔וֹר וְהִֽתְנוֹדְדָ֖ה כַּמְּלוּנָ֑ה וְכָבַ֤ד עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ פִּשְׁעָ֔הּ וְנָפְלָ֖ה וְלֹא־ תֹסִ֥יף קֽוּם׃ס
verses.transliteration: nō·w·a‘ tā·nū·a‘ ’e·reṣ kaš·šik·kō·wr wə·hiṯ·nō·wḏ·ḏāh kam·mə·lū·nāh wə·ḵā·ḇaḏ ‘ā·le·hā piš·‘āh wə·nā·p̄ə·lāh wə·lō- ṯō·sîp̄ qūm
verses.literal: The earth staggers . . . like a drunkard and sways like a shack Earth’s rebellion weighs it down . . . and it falls never to rise again

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יִפְקֹ֧ד יְהוָ֛ה עַל־ צְבָ֥א הַמָּר֖וֹם בַּמָּר֑וֹם וְעַל־ מַלְכֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה עַל־ הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm ha·hū yip̄·qōḏ Yah·weh ‘al- ṣə·ḇā ham·mā·rō·wm bam·mā·rō·wm wə·‘al- mal·ḵê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ‘al- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: In that day the LORD will punish the host of heaven above . . . and the kings of the earth below . . .

verses.original: וְאֻסְּפ֨וּ אֲסֵפָ֤ה אַסִּיר֙ עַל־ בּ֔וֹר וְסֻגְּר֖וּ עַל־ מַסְגֵּ֑ר וּמֵרֹ֥ב יָמִ֖ים יִפָּקֵֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’us·sə·p̄ū ’ă·sê·p̄āh ’as·sîr ‘al- bō·wr wə·sug·gə·rū ‘al- mas·gêr ū·mê·rōḇ yā·mîm yip·pā·qê·ḏū
verses.literal: They will be gathered together like prisoners in a pit They will be confined to a dungeon and punished after many days

verses.original: וְחָֽפְרָה֙ הַלְּבָנָ֔ה וּבוֹשָׁ֖ה הַֽחַמָּ֑ה כִּֽי־ מָלַ֞ךְ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת בְּהַ֤ר צִיּוֹן֙ וּבִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְנֶ֥גֶד זְקֵנָ֖יו כָּבֽוֹד׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥā·p̄ə·rāh hal·lə·ḇā·nāh ū·ḇō·wō·šāh ha·ḥam·māh kî- mā·laḵ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ bə·har ṣî·yō·wn ū·ḇî·rū·šā·lim wə·ne·ḡeḏ zə·qê·nāw kā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: The moon will be confounded and the sun will be ashamed for the LORD of Hosts will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem and before His elders with great glory
